confirmed.title: Your call is booked
confirmed.lede: A confirmation is on its way to your inbox, with a calendar invite and a link to reschedule if you need to. Valentina looks forward to speaking with you.

requested.title: Your request is in
requested.lede: {practitioner} will confirm your call within two days. You'll get an email when it's confirmed, or if a different time is offered. If you don't hear back in 48 hours, the time frees itself and you're welcome to request another.
